newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Cenbank plans T-bills in 10 days-Casas.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Cenbank plans T-bills in 10 days-Casas.

text.p: Venezuela's Central Bank will begin issuing treasury bills alongside TEMs in its open market operations within the next 10 days, bank president Antonio Casas Gonzalez said.

"I expect we'll begin issuing them (the bills) in the next 10 days," said Casas. "They'll probably not be sold at auction, but rather in direct placements, although that is yet to be completely pinned down," he added.

The bills will help the Central Bank rein in inflationary pressure by mopping up excess liquidity caused by a bubble-up in coming weeks on large pending payments by the government and state oil company PDVSA, Casas said.
As of Monday, commercial banks also have to place 15 percent of their deposits in non-interest bearing Central Bank accounts, up from a previous 12 percent.
